text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wheeze... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: So this... is my current limit!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm back!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... But I still have a lot to work on,
like how I
should start my final sprint
and things like that.
choice_data_list: Good work! You really gave it your all.
Good work! You worked really hard.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Real races feel so different from training.
I
couldn't move my legs the way I
wanted to... let
alone put out as much
speed as Yaeno.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's not wrong about that. While
watching her
race, I noticed that her
strides were less sharp and
crisp than I
would've liked.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But I can explain that in a better way to
her.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh... So in other words, they lack the
ability to
give out explosive bursts of
power, right?
choice_data_list: She must have a closing kick that steadily closes the gap.
She must have a closing kick that steadily closes the gap, huh.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh! I've never thought about it like that!
choice_data_list: On the flip side, you've got the tenacity to hold out that much longer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While watching her write in her
notebook, I turn
my mind to the next
issue at hand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the moment, her ultimate goal is to
win the
Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In that case, she'll need to cultivate the

determination to take control of her
races, and
learn how to seize the perfect
moment to make a
move.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In order to put all of our energy into the
Derby,
we'll have to aim for a top race
next.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh? What? A... a G1?!
choice_data_list: Why don't you try running in a GⅠ?
Want to try entering a GⅠ?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Y-yes! If it's okay, I want to race in the
Asahi Hai
Futurity Stakes! Please!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes is a
1,600-meter
race on turf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I was thinking more of the

2,000-meter Hopeful Stakes—as a

medium-distance turf race like the
Derby, it
seems the more natural choice,
but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I want to run in the same race
Maruzen won!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The excitement in her tone is practically
palpable.
There's only one thing I can
say to her twinkling
eyes.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yesss! Thank you! I'll do my best!
choice_data_list: Then let's train hard for the Asahi Hai FS!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...And that's how we decided to take on
the Asahi
Hai Futurity Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That means you will be the only one
among us to
take on the challenge of
becoming the junior
champion.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean I'll be the only one?
Aren't
you running in it, Yaeno?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No. My legs have not yet improved
sufficiently,
so my debut has been
delayed.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
But this is a good opportunity. Ever since
that
day...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The Derby. My dream is to run in the
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting to see the moment you
bare
your fangs.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
All I do is for the sake of repaying my

grandfather. All I do is for the sake of
my training.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I will take this opportunity to
assess
your abilities at the Asahi Hai
Futurity Stakes.
Well then, I'll be off.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: O-okay...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Perhaps I should go watch you too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: To... assess me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Who can say?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Though of course, I'll only be able to go
if I get
permission from my physician.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Do your best, Chiyono O. I'll be
cheering you on.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you. Of course. I'll do my best.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...They're both gone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that the flame of destiny has been
lit, our
next step is the Asahi Hai
Futurity Stakes.
